name: Campus Felix
summary: Felix will take a free Visa card as a backup but will never make it primary. The only viable product: zero fee + guaranteed grocery cashback above CHF 5/month. Welcome bonuses and travel perks are wasted spend for this segment.

price_sensitivity.finding: Rejects fixed costs instinctively. Prefers variable fees over monthly commitments — even when variable is mathematically worse.
price_sensitivity.key_quote: Fixed costs hurt more than occasional fees.

feature_preference.finding: Grocery cashback is the only meaningful trigger. Travel insurance and foreign fee waiver are irrelevant — Felix barely travels.
feature_preference.key_quote: Rewards on flights don't make sense for me.

behavior_switching.finding: Twint is the anchor. Will only switch if the card is free AND delivers visible monthly savings. Speed and simplicity are non-negotiable.
behavior_switching.key_quote: It would need to be free and clearly save me money every month.

trade_off.finding: Does the math correctly but remains hesitant even at net positive. Psychological resistance to fees is stronger than rational calculation.
trade_off.key_quote: I'd want to be sure CHF 15 is realistic, not just marketing.

willingness_to_pay.finding: Absolute ceiling is CHF 5/month, only with guaranteed cashback on existing spending. Would take a free card as backup with no rewards.
willingness_to_pay.key_quote: Max CHF 5, and only if I clearly earn more back than I pay.

visa_recommendation.viable_product: Free Visa card with guaranteed grocery cashback exceeding CHF 5/month
visa_recommendation.acquisition_trigger: Zero fee + transparent cashback on Migros/Coop
